name: filey-mobile

scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && cap open android

description: Filey mobile shell. React/Vite/Tailwind resolve from the repo root node_modules (single dependency tree with the desktop app); this manifest only adds what the desktop lacks — the Capacitor native stack and Tailwind's Vite plugin.
